children: Camden announced that D. Keith Oden retired as Executive Vice Chairman of the Board of Trust Managers, effective August 31, 2026, and will remain a board member.
Executive Vice Chairman of the Board of Trust Managers (retired); continues as member of the Board of Trust Managers
Retired (from Executive Vice Chairman); continued board membership

Employment agreement terminated; will receive payments representing anticipated value of accrued amounts through Feb 2027 credited to a cash deferral account under the Company's Non-Qualified Deferred Compensation Plan
Remains a member of the Board of Trust Managers
